natural: I am grateful for your kind regard

meaning.en: A humble thanks for someone's generous favour, support or affection.
meaning.zh: 谦虚地感谢对方的厚待、关照或喜爱。

equivalents: thank you for your kind favour
I am honoured by your kindness

examples.zh: 承蒙厚爱，我一定不辜负大家的期望。
examples.en: I am grateful for your kind regard and will not let you down.

examples.zh: 多年来承蒙厚爱，本店特推出会员回馈活动。
examples.en: After years of your generous support, our shop is launching a loyalty offer.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble expression): the speaker thanks others for their favour. Formal, used in speeches, letters and shop notices.
usage.zh: 谦辞：说话人感谢对方的厚待。正式，常见于致辞、信函和商家告示。

natural: excuse me, I must leave you

meaning.en: A courteous way of saying you must leave or step away from someone's company.
meaning.zh: 因故要先离开时对对方说的客气话。

equivalents: I'll have to leave you now

examples.zh: 我还有个会，先失陪了。
examples.en: I have a meeting, so please excuse me.

examples.zh: 对不起，我接个电话，失陪一下。
examples.en: Sorry, I need to take a call; excuse me for a moment.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble): said by the one who leaves, never to the person leaving. Neutral to formal; often 失陪了 or 先失陪.
usage.zh: 谦辞：由离开的人说，不对离开的人说。中性偏正式，常说“失陪了”“先失陪”。

natural: please don't trouble to see me out

meaning.en: What a departing guest says to stop the host from walking them out.
meaning.zh: 客人告别时请主人不要远送。

equivalents: no need to see me out

examples.zh: 请留步，不用送了。
examples.en: Please don't come any further; there's no need to see me out.

examples.zh: 外面冷，主任请留步。
examples.en: It's cold outside, so please don't come out, Director.

usage.en: 敬辞 (courteous, about the other person): said by the guest, not the host. Often paired with the host's 慢走. Neutral.
usage.zh: 敬辞：由客人对主人说，常与主人的“慢走”配合。中性。

natural: please forgive me for not seeing you far

meaning.en: A polite or sometimes pointed formula said by a host when a guest leaves, excusing oneself from walking them out.
meaning.zh: 主人送客时的客套话，表示不再远送。

equivalents: forgive me for not seeing you out
I won't see you to the door

examples.zh: 您路上小心，恕不远送。
examples.en: Take care on the road; forgive me for not seeing you further.

examples.zh: 既然话不投机，恕不远送。
examples.en: Since we clearly disagree, I will not see you out.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble) from the host. In old novels and modern banter it can sound curt or sarcastic, meaning 'there's the door'. Formal or humorous.
usage.zh: 主人的谦辞。在旧小说和现代调侃中有时带逐客的意味，显得冷淡或讽刺。正式或戏谑。

natural: mind how you go, I won't see you out

meaning.en: A casual farewell from the host, often meaning 'go carefully; I won't walk you out'.
meaning.zh: 主人送客的口语告别语，意为“路上慢点，我就不送了”。

equivalents: take care, I won't see you out

examples.zh: 好的，您慢走不送。
examples.en: All right, mind how you go; I won't see you out.

examples.zh: 她笑着对要走的同事说：“慢走不送！”
examples.en: She smiled at the colleague who was leaving and said, 'Off you go, then!'

usage.en: Friendly between close people, but said sharply it means 'good riddance'. Tone decides the meaning. Casual.
usage.zh: 亲近的人之间是客气话，语气冷淡时则有“快走吧”的意思，全看语气。口语。

meaning.en: The standard greeting of shops, restaurants and hotels to arriving customers.
meaning.zh: 商店、餐馆、酒店对来客的标准问候语。

examples.zh: 店员微笑着说：“欢迎光临！”
examples.en: The assistant smiled and said, 'Welcome!'

examples.zh: 门口的牌子上写着“欢迎光临”。
examples.en: The sign at the door reads 'Welcome'.

usage.en: 敬辞: 光临 honours the visitor's arrival. Used by businesses and hosts; customers do not say it back. Neutral, standard on signs.
usage.zh: 敬辞：“光临”是敬称对方到来。多由商家或主人说，顾客不回答此语。中性，招牌常用。

natural: please honour my humble home with a visit

meaning.en: A humble invitation asking someone to visit one's home.
meaning.zh: 谦虚地邀请对方到自己家中做客。

equivalents: do honour my house with a visit

examples.zh: 改日定当请您光临寒舍。
examples.en: I shall invite you to honour my humble home one day.

examples.zh: 盼老师有空光临寒舍小坐。
examples.en: I hope you will find time to visit my humble home, teacher.

usage.en: Mixes 敬辞 光临 (for the guest) and 谦辞 寒舍 (for one's own home). Formal, slightly old-fashioned, often humorous today.
usage.zh: “光临”是敬辞，“寒舍”是谦辞，合起来用。正式，略显古雅，今天常带玩笑口吻。

natural: forgive me for not welcoming you properly

meaning.en: A humble apology from a host for not greeting a guest at the door or from afar.
meaning.zh: 主人对客人表示没有远道迎接的歉意。

equivalents: forgive me for not meeting you
sorry I did not come out to greet you

examples.zh: 不知您大驾光临，有失远迎，还请见谅。
examples.en: I did not know you were coming, and forgive me for failing to greet you properly.

examples.zh: 王总来了？有失远迎！
examples.en: Mr Wang is here? Forgive me for not meeting you!

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble) said by the host on meeting a guest. Formal; heard in period dramas and ceremonious or jokey modern speech.
usage.zh: 主人见客时说的谦辞。正式，古装剧中常听到，今天也用于郑重或玩笑场合。

meaning.en: A respectful way to ask someone's age, mostly of a peer or someone of middle age.
meaning.zh: 客气地询问对方年龄。

equivalents: how old are you, if I may ask

examples.zh: 老先生，请问贵庚？
examples.en: Sir, may I ask how old you are?

examples.zh: 您看着真年轻，不知贵庚几何？
examples.en: You look so young; may I ask how old you are?

usage.en: 敬辞 (about the other person) used only in questions. Slightly archaic and humorous today. 高寿 is for the elderly.
usage.zh: 敬辞，只用于询问。今天略显古旧，常带戏谑。询问老人多用“高寿”。

meaning.en: A respectful term for an old person's age, used to ask how old they are or to praise their long life.
meaning.zh: 对老人年龄的敬称，用来询问或赞美其长寿。

equivalents: how old are you, sir (to an elder)

examples.zh: 老人家高寿了？
examples.en: How old are you, grandfather, if I may ask?

examples.zh: 她活到九十八岁，真是高寿。
examples.en: She lived to ninety-eight, a very good age.

usage.en: 敬辞 for the elderly (usually over 60 or so). Do not use it of a young person or of oneself. Formal and warm.
usage.zh: 对老人的敬辞，一般指六十岁以上。不用于年轻人或自己。正式而亲切。

meaning.en: A respectful term for the other person's father.
meaning.zh: 对别人父亲的敬称。

examples.zh: 令尊身体可好？
examples.en: Is your father in good health?

examples.zh: 久闻令尊大名。
examples.en: I have long heard of your esteemed father.

usage.en: 敬辞: only for the other person's father, never for your own (use 家父). 令堂, 令郎 and 令爱 follow the same pattern. Formal, old-fashioned.
usage.zh: 敬辞：只称对方的父亲，不能称自己的父亲（自称用“家父”）。“令堂”“令郎”“令爱”同理。正式，较古雅。

meaning.en: A respectful term for the other person's mother.
meaning.zh: 对别人母亲的敬称。

examples.zh: 请代我向令堂问好。
examples.en: Please give my regards to your mother.

examples.zh: 听说令堂最近身体不适？
examples.en: I hear your mother has been unwell lately?

usage.en: 敬辞: for the other person's mother only; for your own use 家母. Formal, found in letters and period drama.
usage.zh: 敬辞：只称对方的母亲，自称母亲用“家母”。正式，见于书信和古装剧。

meaning.en: A respectful term for the other person's son.
meaning.zh: 对别人儿子的敬称。

examples.zh: 令郎今年高考，一定考得不错吧？
examples.en: Your son took the exam this year; I'm sure he did well.

examples.zh: 令郎一表人才，真是羡慕。
examples.en: Your son is so talented; I envy you.

usage.en: 敬辞: for someone else's son; for your own use 犬子. Formal. Daughters are 令爱 or 令嫒.
usage.zh: 敬辞：称别人的儿子；自称儿子用“犬子”。正式。称别人女儿用“令爱”。

meaning.en: A respectful term for the other person's daughter.
meaning.zh: 对别人女儿的敬称。

examples.zh: 令爱聪明伶俐，将来必成大器。
examples.en: Your daughter is bright and quick; she will go far.

examples.zh: 不知令爱是否已经婚配？
examples.en: May I ask whether your daughter is married?

usage.en: 敬辞: for someone else's daughter; also written 令嫒. Formal and rather literary; rare in everyday speech.
usage.zh: 敬辞：称别人的女儿，也写作“令嫒”。正式，偏书面，日常少用。

meaning.en: A humble term for one's own father when speaking to others.
meaning.zh: 对别人称呼自己父亲时的谦称。

examples.zh: 家父年事已高，不便远行。
examples.en: My father is getting on and cannot travel far.

examples.zh: 这是家父留下的老宅。
examples.en: This is the old house my father left.

usage.en: 谦辞: for your own father in front of others; the other person's father is 令尊. Formal; 家 prefixes elder relatives (家母, 家兄).
usage.zh: 谦辞：对人称自己的父亲；称对方父亲用“令尊”。正式；“家”字用于称自己的长辈亲属（家母、家兄）。

meaning.en: A humble term for one's own mother when speaking to others.
meaning.zh: 对别人称呼自己母亲时的谦称。

examples.zh: 家母昨天刚出院。
examples.en: My mother was discharged only yesterday.

examples.zh: 家母常说，做人要厚道。
examples.en: My mother always says one should be kind-hearted.

usage.en: 谦辞: for your own mother; the other person's mother is 令堂. Formal and slightly old-fashioned.
usage.zh: 谦辞：称自己的母亲；称对方母亲用“令堂”。正式，略显古雅。

meaning.en: A self-deprecating term for one's own son, humbly comparing him to a dog.
meaning.zh: 谦称自己的儿子，把他比作犬。

examples.zh: 犬子顽劣，还请多多管教。
examples.en: My son is naughty; please discipline him as you see fit.

examples.zh: 犬子今年刚刚大学毕业。
examples.en: My son has only just graduated from university.

usage.en: 谦辞: only for your own son, in front of others; the other person's son is 令郎. Formal, slightly humorous today; 小儿 is similar.
usage.zh: 谦辞：只对人称自己的儿子；称对方儿子用“令郎”。正式，今天略带诙谐；“小儿”类似。

meaning.en: A humble, old-style way for a man to refer to his own wife.
meaning.zh: 男子对别人称自己妻子的谦称。

examples.zh: 内人今天不在家。
examples.en: My wife is not at home today.

examples.zh: 这是内人，她在医院工作。
examples.en: This is my wife; she works at the hospital.

usage.en: 谦辞 used by husbands about their wives. Old-fashioned; many now find 内 (inside) outdated and say 我爱人 or 我太太. Formal.
usage.zh: 丈夫对别人称妻子的谦辞。较古旧，今天多说“我爱人”“我太太”。正式。

meaning.en: A very humble, now old-fashioned term for one's own wife.
meaning.zh: 旧时对人谦称自己的妻子。

examples.zh: 贱内不懂事，还请见谅。
examples.en: My wife is unknowing; please forgive her.

examples.zh: 他在饭局上开玩笑说：“贱内管得严。”
examples.en: At the dinner he joked, 'My wife keeps me on a tight leash.'

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble): 贱 means 'lowly' and sounds demeaning to the wife to modern ears, so it is mostly heard in period drama or as a joke. Prefer 内人 or 我太太 today.
usage.zh: 谦辞：“贱”有轻贱之意，今天听来有贬低妻子之嫌，多见于古装剧或玩笑。现在宜用“内人”“我太太”。

meaning.en: A respectful word for the other person's home or family.
meaning.zh: 对别人的家或家人的敬称。

examples.zh: 改天一定去府上拜访。
examples.en: I shall certainly call at your house some day.

examples.zh: 请问府上是哪里人？
examples.en: May I ask where your family comes from?

usage.en: 敬辞: about the other person's home, native place or family; one's own is 敝处 or 寒舍. Formal and old-fashioned.
usage.zh: 敬辞：称对方的家、籍贯或家人；自己的家则称“敝处”“寒舍”。正式，较古雅。

meaning.en: A respectful form of address for 'you', used in diplomatic and very formal writing.
meaning.zh: 对对方的敬称，多用于外交和极正式的书面场合。

examples.zh: 大使阁下，欢迎您来访。
examples.en: Welcome, Your Excellency the Ambassador.

examples.zh: 阁下的意见，我们会认真考虑。
examples.en: We shall give careful consideration to your views.

usage.en: 敬辞: 'beneath the pavilion', i.e. addressing someone through their attendants. Used in diplomacy, formal letters and martial-arts fiction; stilted in ordinary talk.
usage.zh: 敬辞：原指对在“阁”下的侍从说话，以示尊敬。用于外交、正式书信和武侠小说，日常说来显得拘谨。

meaning.en: A humble apology for a lapse in manners, in the style of old fiction.
meaning.zh: 旧小说式的谦辞，为自己的失礼道歉。

examples.zh: 方才多喝了几杯，在下失礼了。
examples.en: I had a few too many just now; forgive my rudeness.

examples.zh: 他拱手道：“在下失礼，诸位莫怪。”
examples.en: He bowed with clasped hands and said, 'Pardon my manners, gentlemen.'

usage.en: 谦辞 with 在下 ('the one below') for 'I'. Literary, from period dramas and martial-arts novels; used playfully today.
usage.zh: 谦辞，“在下”是自称。带文言色彩，多见于古装剧和武侠小说，现今多用于玩笑。

natural: I have given offence on many occasions

meaning.en: A humble apology for having offended someone more than once.
meaning.zh: 谦虚地为自己多次冒犯对方道歉。

equivalents: I may have offended you often

examples.zh: 以前多有得罪，请您大人不记小人过。
examples.en: I offended you many times before; please be generous and forget it.

examples.zh: 交接工作中多有得罪，还望海涵。
examples.en: I may have stepped on toes during the handover; I hope you will forgive me.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble): usually spoken at partings, ends of projects or toasts. Often followed by 还请海涵. Formal.
usage.zh: 谦辞：多用于离别、项目结束或敬酒时，后面常接“还请海涵”。正式。

meaning.en: A polite request for patience and forgiveness for one's shortcomings.
meaning.zh: 客气地请对方对自己的不足多加谅解。

examples.zh: 我刚学汉语，说得不好，请多包涵。
examples.en: I've only just started Chinese and speak badly, so please bear with me.

examples.zh: 今天准备仓促，有不周之处，请多包涵。
examples.en: The preparations were hasty and there are shortcomings; please bear with us.

usage.en: 谦辞 (humble): spoken by the one at fault or the host. Also written 多多包涵; 包涵 alone means 'to forgive'. Neutral, polite.
usage.zh: 谦辞：由有不足的一方或主人说，也说“多多包涵”；单说“包涵”即“原谅”。中性，礼貌。
